slices.focus: Saira and Tom open a dedicated savings pot for Lisbon and house contingencies
slices.summary: With the wedding paid off and renovation spending easing, Saira and Tom open a shared savings pot split between a Lisbon trip and a house contingency buffer. Saira sets a rule that family help comes from monthly cash flow, not the buffer, and plans a modest first threshold target.
